items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: Clapton, Eric Clapton I never had an opportunity to do anything with him, meaning like either a session or have him sit in.

ctx.x: A Gibson ES 175, Epiphone, I have the Epiphone also, and then I would bring a 335, which is a Gibson also. That I find the most, the best recording guitar was the 335. That’s what Eric Clapton uses a lot. A 335. It’s a great guitar. It’s all around. But acoustic wise of course not, not for acoustic.
